gloss: one grain; one drop; a single small round thing

definitions.gloss: one grain; one drop; a single small round item
definitions.explanation: A single instance of something small and roundish: a grain of rice, a drop of water, a single berry, a pill, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一粒|ひとつぶ}⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一粒|ひとつぶ}⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}った→伝う：28247_tsutau⟧。
examples.english: A single tear ran down her cheek.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{一粒|ひとつぶ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧にしたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to waste even a single grain of the carefully cultivated rice.

notes:
{一|ひと} (one) + ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧ (grain, drop, particle). The counter ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧ applies to small, roundish items.

COUNTING WITH {粒|つぶ}:
- {一粒|ひとつぶ}: one grain
- {二粒|ふたつぶ}: two grains
- {三粒|みつぶ}: three grains
- {何粒|なんつぶ}: how many grains

TYPICAL USES:
- {米|こめ}{一粒|ひとつぶ}: a grain of rice
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧{一粒|ひとつぶ}: one pill, one tablet
- ⟦{雨粒|あまつぶ}→雨粒：20328_amatsubu⟧{一粒|ひとつぶ}: a single raindrop
- ⟦{真珠|しんじゅ}→真珠：19873_shinju⟧{一粒|ひとつぶ}: a single pearl
- ぶどう{一粒|ひとつぶ}: a single grape (one berry from a bunch)

FIGURATIVE: {一粒|ひとつぶ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧にしない ('not waste a single grain') is a common expression about cherishing every bit.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一房|ひとふさ}→一房：27641_hitofusa⟧: a cluster — used for the whole bunch that contains many ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧
- ⟦{一滴|いってき}→一滴：08893_itteki⟧: a drop — specifically for liquid
